This does not select a host theme or subscribe to theme changes. Pass the same live theme to both Entry and Macro rendering.%
content.markdown: Compiles a Kind Palette for the selected light/dark scheme into hover and binding-scope CSS. Text uses the solid selected stroke; highlight outline and fill use 50% alpha. This does not select a host theme or subscribe to theme changes. Pass the same live theme to both Entry and Macro rendering.
